saw_lines: Shoppers pick comfort footwear by how it feels after a full day, then come back for a second pair in another style.
So the sale is won in the opening line, where shoppers judge the offer and fit before they click.
Your site offers 10% off your first order, yet only 1 of 21 ads mention it. Open three ads with that offer in line one, printed on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers 10% off the first order, but only 1 of 21 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act. Open three ads with that offer in line one and print the 10% on the creative.

Your site offers free shipping, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a buyer must leave the ad for the answer. Open three ads with the free shipping line and the delivery window from your policy page.

Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 30 ads mention a subscription, so repeat buyers never hear they can save by reordering. Run two retention ads for past buyers with subscribe and save as the headline.
None of your 21 ads with copy carries a proof number, so buyers have no figure to trust. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and open two ads with it in the first line.
